data.long_description:
Experience elegant Mediterranean-inspired living with this 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom townhouse located in the highly desirable Damac Lagoons Santorini.

With a BUA of 2,227 sq. ft. set on a 1,550 sq. ft. plot, this beautifully designed home offers a perfect balance of indoor comfort and outdoor charm. The standout feature is the lush landscaped garden, ideal for family gatherings, outdoor dining, or simply relaxing in a serene setting.

The townhouse features spacious open-plan living and dining areas, complemented by modern finishes and abundant natural light. All four bedrooms are generously sized and come with en-suite bathrooms, ensuring privacy and convenience, while the additional bathroom caters seamlessly to guests.

Situated within Damac Lagoons, residents enjoy access to world-class amenities, crystal-clear lagoons, leisure spaces, and a vibrant community lifestyle inspired by coastal living.

Perfect for families or investors, this property presents a rare opportunity to own a stylish home with a private garden in one of Dubai’s most sought-after lagoon communities.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
